title: Oharu ThemeV1
description: Button and text colors only. Page/card surfaces, separators, shapes, fonts and layout stay unchanged. The nine ThemeV1 fields remain compatible with older files; the runtime normalizes reserved surface colors to their fixed brand values before contrast checks. Only none/off visuals are enabled. Imports remain drafts until explicit Apply. No URL, CSS, JavaScript, layout or account fields are accepted.

name.description: The current JavaScript validator also limits the name to 40 UTF-16 code units; astral Unicode symbols use two units.

bg.description: Reserved surface token, normalized to #F2F4F6. A valid legacy #RRGGBB value is accepted for compatibility but never recolors this surface.

card.description: Reserved surface token, normalized to #FFFFFF. A valid legacy #RRGGBB value is accepted for compatibility but never recolors this surface.

soft.description: Reserved surface token, normalized to #E8F3FF. A valid legacy #RRGGBB value is accepted for compatibility but never recolors this surface.

line.description: Reserved surface token, normalized to #F2F4F6. A valid legacy #RRGGBB value is accepted for compatibility but never recolors this surface.

dangerSoft.description: Reserved surface token, normalized to #FEECEE. A valid legacy #RRGGBB value is accepted for compatibility but never recolors this surface.

$comment: The runtime normalizes bg/card/soft/line/dangerSoft to #F2F4F6/#FFFFFF/#E8F3FF/#F2F4F6/#FEECEE. It then enforces text/bg, text/card, muted/bg, muted/card, accent/bg, accent/card, accent/soft, danger/card, danger/dangerSoft and #FFFFFF/accent WCAG contrast >=4.5:1. Saved legacy themes are checked against their original surfaces before unreadable foregrounds are replaced with readable brand values; restoring never writes account metadata. File imports are limited to 8192 bytes; JSON string validation limits input to 8192 UTF-16 code units.
